reviews.comment:
Llegue por la madrugada al lugar muy temprano y allí me atendieron muy cordialmente.  Carque el tanque de gas oil de mi camioneta me hicieron el descuento por ser socio sin problemas.
Antes de retirarme el empleado de la playa limpio los vidrios de mi vehiculo con entusiamo.
La atencion me parecio exelente.

(Translated by Google)
I arrived very early in the morning and was greeted warmly. I filled up my truck's diesel tank and received the member discount without any issues.
Before I left, the attendant enthusiastically cleaned my vehicle's windows.
The service was excellent.
